title: digitaria pruriens var. microbachne
intro: Digitaria pruriens var. microbachne, commonly known as Dhamasa, is a type of plant species in the grass family (Poaceae). This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dhamasa include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Dhamasa are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential in developing new treatments for various diseases.
